svg.title: Multi-agent orchestration: CentralBrain → Orchestrator → 17 domain shells
svg.desc: A strategic objective is sanitized, enriched, decomposed, assigned to specialists, refined, and the best answers are learned.
svg.text: Multi-agent orchestration: CentralBrain → Orchestrator → 17 domain shells
A strategic objective is sanitized, enriched, decomposed, assigned to specialists, refined, and the best answers are learned.
e.g. “Review code quality, assess our cloud costs and define OKRs for Q3” → CentralBrainAgent.process()
and safe to store go back to
tactical level · MetaheuristicEngine picks the algorithm by problem size
best keyword match per task, zero overhead
Then: parallel batches that respect the dependency graph (dependsOn + canParallelize) → aggregate the results.
lazy factory + semantic scoring · every shell implements IDomainAgentShell
Each shell: use cases → checkGuardrails() → block · warn · pass (e.g. EU AI Act tier, LTV:CAC < 3, runway < 6 months, ADR traceability).
